verdict.rationale: Adyen's first-party docs describe webhooks that push event-driven HTTP POST messages to an endpoint you define, so you don't have to poll. They also cover HMAC signature verification, troubleshooting failed deliveries in the Customer Area, and documented event types such as account settings webhooks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, explicit docs on how to subscribe and choose events per endpoint, and evidence of platform-specific (balance platform) webhook event types.
